name: stepbystep
description: Skills that turn a big request into a build plan later agent sessions execute one reviewable step at a time.

plugins.name: stepbystep
plugins.description: The default edition. Full build plan with tracker, per-step prompts, verify lines, rollback, landmines, and a not-building list. The agent never commits: it hands you one commit + push block per step.

plugins.name: stepbystep-portable
plugins.description: Tool-neutral edition. Same full format with generic model tiers and a commit convention you choose per plan (human commits, agent commits, or agent commits and pushes).

plugins.name: stepbystep-lite
plugins.description: Lightweight edition for 3-8 step features and fixes. One compact plan file: scope, tracker, opening prompt, and per-step prompts with verify lines. Small and cheap to load.

plugins.name: stepbystep-autopilot
plugins.description: Autonomous edition. The agent commits each green step, runs a whole phase, and opens a pull request per phase, stopping at human checkpoints and explicit stop conditions.
